visual_goal: Contrast the iCal mesh, where three platforms poll each other over six links and nobody holds the truth, with the hub, where one system of record pushes in seconds.
prompt: A side-by-side comparison in two panels. Left panel labeled 'iCal mesh': three calendar boxes in a triangle labeled 'Nookaway', 'Competitor' and 'OTA homes', each pair joined by two thin dashed arrows, one in each direction, six dashed arrows in total, and in the middle one small hourglass icon with the label 'hours'. Right panel labeled 'Hub': one central box labeled 'Host PMS' with exactly three solid one-way arrows outward to three calendar boxes labeled 'Nookaway', 'Competitor' and 'OTA homes', plus exactly one thin return arrow from 'Nookaway' back into 'Host PMS'; one single small stopwatch icon in the panel with the label 'seconds', used once only.
alt: Left: three platforms joined by six polled dashed links taking hours. Right: one host PMS pushing to three platforms in seconds, with reservations returning from Nookaway.

visual_goal: Show imports, partner API writes and bookings becoming claims in Almanac, with the exporter and the conflict detector reacting to the store and conflicts and health problems raising host alerts.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Top-left corner: a small heart-rate monitor box labeled 'Sync health'. Directly below it, a download tray labeled 'iCal imports', with one short arrow from 'iCal imports' up into 'Sync health'. Below 'iCal imports': a plug labeled 'Partner API', and below that a confirmation slip labeled 'Bookings'. One arrow from each of 'iCal imports', 'Partner API' and 'Bookings' into a large central ledger of colored date tiles labeled 'Almanac claims'. Right of the ledger: an upload tray labeled 'iCal exporter' and an alarm detector labeled 'Conflict detector', each receiving one arrow from the ledger. At the far right, a bell box labeled 'Host alert', receiving one arrow from 'Conflict detector' and one long arrow along the top from 'Sync health'.
alt: iCal imports, partner API writes and bookings become claims in Almanac; the exporter and conflict detector react to the claims, and conflicts and sync-health problems raise host alerts.

visual_goal: Show the life of an imported calendar link: Healthy, Stale after 2 intervals, Failing after 24 hours, Broken after 72 hours, plus Quarantined for implausible drops, with recovery paths back to Healthy.
prompt: A state map of five rounded tiles. A large green tile 'Healthy' at the left. To the right, a horizontal chain of three tiles: yellow 'Stale', orange 'Failing', red 'Broken'. Arrows forward along the chain: from 'Healthy' to 'Stale' labeled '2 intervals', from 'Stale' to 'Failing' labeled '24 hours', from 'Failing' to 'Broken' labeled '72 hours'. Below 'Healthy', a purple tile 'Quarantined', with one arrow down from 'Healthy' labeled 'implausible drop' and one arrow back up to 'Healthy' labeled 'confirmed'. Three curved return arrows along the top, one from each of 'Stale', 'Failing' and 'Broken' back to 'Healthy'.
alt: Calendar link states: Healthy, then Stale after 2 intervals, Failing after 24 hours and Broken after 72 hours, each able to return to Healthy, plus Quarantined after an implausible drop.

visual_goal: Show the Seville double booking under Calendar Sync v2: the conflict still happens, but Nookaway detects it at 10:45 and alerts Carmen and support.
prompt: A simple left-to-right timeline along a horizontal ribbon with three clock markers labeled '10:12', '10:40' and '10:45'. Above '10:12', a blue booking card labeled 'Nookaway'. Below '10:40', an orange booking card labeled 'Competitor'. Above '10:45', a small calendar with a blue bar and an orange bar overlapping, labeled 'conflict'. From the calendar one arrow to the right into a bell icon next to a generic woman holding a phone, with the single word 'Carmen' under her. No other people. The only words in the image are '10:12', '10:40', '10:45', 'Nookaway', 'Competitor', 'conflict' and 'Carmen'.
alt: Timeline: the family books on Nookaway at 10:12, a competitor guest books at 10:40, and at 10:45 Nookaway's import finds the overlap and alerts Carmen and support.
